infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TrackDown uses the camera so you can photograph a machine, a display or a plate instead of typing what you did.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TrackDown attaches photos from your library to a log as evidence for what you did or ate.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: TrackDown listens while you narrate a log. The audio never leaves your phone.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: TrackDown transcribes what you say on the device itself, so you can log a workout without typing.
